components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action. Deep Graphite on Off-White. Square corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background-color: #1F2024; color: #E1E1E1; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; user-select: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1F2024; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(31,32,36,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent at rest, muted background on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background-color: transparent; color: #1F2024; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: #EDEDED; color: #1F2024; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #D4D4D8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(31,32,36,0.5); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Delete and irreversible actions. Expense Red text, transparent at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background-color: transparent; color: #F43F5E; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background-color: rgba(244,63,94,0.10); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(244,63,94,0.40); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(244,63,94,0.20); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field. Square corners, transparent background, cool border.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 10px; background-color: transparent; color: #1F2024; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid #D4D4D8; border-radius: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #787882; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #1F2024; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(31,32,36,0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #F43F5E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(244,63,94,0.20); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; background-color: rgba(212,212,216,0.5); }

components.name: Navigation Tab (Active)
components.description: Primary view-switcher. Two cards spanning full width below the header. Large, tappable, with a decorative icon.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; padding-bottom: 64px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0; position: relative; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; user-select: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.10s ease; } .ds-nav-tab:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-nav-tab--active { background-color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #D4D4D8; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-nav-tab--inactive { background-color: transparent; border-color: rgba(212,212,216,0.40); } .ds-nav-tab__label { font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-nav-tab--active .ds-nav-tab__label { color: #1F2024; } .ds-nav-tab--inactive .ds-nav-tab__label { color: rgba(31,32,36,0.55); } .ds-nav-tab__sub { font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-nav-tab--active .ds-nav-tab__sub { color: #787882; } .ds-nav-tab--inactive .ds-nav-tab__sub { color: rgba(31,32,36,0.35); }

components.name: Context Menu
components.description: Portal-rendered action popup appearing above or below a selected transaction row.
components.css: .ds-ctx-menu { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background-color: #EDEDED; border: 1px solid #D4D4D8; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.10); } .ds-ctx-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease; white-space: nowrap; background-color: transparent; } .ds-ctx-btn--edit { color: #1F2024; } .ds-ctx-btn--edit:hover { background-color: rgba(31,32,36,0.10); } .ds-ctx-btn--delete { color: #F43F5E; } .ds-ctx-btn--delete:hover { background-color: rgba(244,63,94,0.10); } .ds-ctx-divider { width: 1px; height: 20px; background-color: #D4D4D8; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Varo holds one conviction: the numbers are the voice, and the interface whispers. Every element earns its place by making a figure clearer or an action faster. Decoration is not restrained here; it is absent.

The palette is a cool graphite study. Neutrals carry a blue undertone throughout, running from the near-black of Deep Graphite (#1F2024) to the near-white of Cool Ash (#F5F5F7). Two functional accents, Income Green and Expense Red, carry the entire emotional signal of the product. Nothing competes with them.

Typography runs through a single face, Nunito Sans, across its full weight range (300–800). Hierarchy is built through weight contrast, not size steps. Inputs and interactive surfaces are square-cornered. The grid is tight. White space is earned, not assumed.
keyCharacteristics: Cool graphite neutrals throughout; no warm tints anywhere in the system
Two semantic accents only: Income Green and Expense Red; nothing decorative
Single typeface (Nunito Sans), hierarchy through weight alone
Square corners (0px radius) on all interactive elements except the circular FAB
Tonal surface lift in place of decorative shadows; shadows reserved for portals and active lifts

rules.name: The Two-Color Rule
rules.body: Income Green and Expense Red are the only saturated colors permitted in the product UI. Their emotional signal depends entirely on their scarcity. A third accent erases the signal.

rules.name: The Cool Purity Rule
rules.body: No warm tints. No beige, no cream, no amber-shifted neutrals. If a gray looks warmer than raw steel, it is not in this system.

rules.name: The Weight-Is-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Size stays compressed; weight does the work. A 13px/700 title above a 12px/500 body creates a clear level change without widening the scale.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A shadow is a claim that something floats above the page. Make that claim only for elements that genuinely do: portals, overlays, and state-lifted surfaces. Everything at rest is flat.

rules.name: The Sharp Edge Rule
rules.body: All interactive surfaces use 0px radius. The FAB (circular by function) and the category badge pill (semantic color, not decoration) are the sole exceptions. Rounded corners on new components are prohibited.

dos: Do use Income Green (#10B981) and Expense Red (#F43F5E) exclusively for their semantic roles.
Do use 0px radius for all new interactive elements. The FAB is the sole exception.
Do differentiate surfaces through tonal background steps, not added shadows.
Do use weight contrast (500/700/800) to build typographic hierarchy. Avoid expanding the size scale.
Do write all UI copy in Spanish. The product is native to Spanish, not translated from English.
Do gate every animation behind @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
donts: Don't introduce a third saturated accent. The signal of Income Green and Expense Red depends on their being the only two.
Don't apply warm tints to any neutral. No beige, no cream, no amber. Every gray runs cool.
Don't use gradient fills, decorative blurs, or glassmorphism. The system is opaque and flat.
Don't stripe list items or callouts with a left or right border accent wider than 1px.
Don't apply gradient text (background-clip: text). Amounts are bold and single-color.
Don't look to BBVA/Santander, Mint/YNAB, or crypto neon-on-black as compositional references.
Don't use rounded corners wider than 0px on new components.
Don't add shadows to components at rest.
